title: Detailed candle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='wax' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#c8e6f5'/>
      <stop offset='0.3' stop-color='#f2fbff'/>
      <stop offset='0.55' stop-color='#e2f3fc'/>
      <stop offset='0.8' stop-color='#9fd0e8'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#7fb8d6'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='wax2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#a9d6ec'/>
      <stop offset='0.4' stop-color='#e8f7ff'/>
      <stop offset='0.75' stop-color='#bfe3f4'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#86bdd8'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='plate' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffe08a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#c98f2e'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- flame outer glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='13' ry='18' fill='#ff8a1e' opacity='0.45'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='31' rx='9' ry='14' fill='#ffb52e' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- flame body -->
  <path d='M50 10 C57 20 62 27 62 34 C62 41 57 46 50 46 C43 46 38 41 38 34 C38 27 43 20 50 10 Z' fill='#ff9a1a'/>
  <path d='M50 16 C55 23 58 28 58 34 C58 39 54 43 50 43 C46 43 42 39 42 34 C42 28 45 23 50 16 Z' fill='#ffd94a'/>
  <path d='M50 24 C53 29 54 32 54 35 C54 38 52 40 50 40 C48 40 46 38 46 35 C46 32 47 29 50 24 Z' fill='#fff8dc'/>

  <!-- wick -->
  <path d='M50 46 L50 52' stroke='#7a4a1e' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 46 L50 52' stroke='#b06a2a' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- candle body, with drips -->
  <path d='M38 54
           C38 52 40 51 42 51
           L42 49 C42 47 44 47 45 49 L45 51
           L48 51
           L48 47 C48 45 50 45 50 47 L50 51
           L53 51
           L53 49.5 C53 47.5 55 47.5 55 49.5 L55 51
           C58 51 60 52 60 54
           L60 84 C60 87 58 88 55 88
           L45 88 C42 88 40 87 40 84
           Z' fill='url(#wax)'/>

  <!-- wax shading on the left -->
  <path d='M40 56 L40 84 C40 87 42 88 45 88 L45 56 Z' fill='#8fc4de' opacity='0.35'/>

  <!-- warm glow on the right from flame -->
  <path d='M55 54 L55 87 C58 87 60 86 60 84 L60 54 Z' fill='#ffcf6b' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- flame reflection highlight on wax top -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='8' ry='2.2' fill='#ffd97a' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- drip shading lines -->
  <path d='M46 54 L46 66' stroke='#d3ecf8' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M52 54 L52 62' stroke='#d3ecf8' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- rim highlight -->
  <path d='M42 51.5 L58 51.5' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.2' opacity='0.9' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- holder / base plate -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='22' ry='5.5' fill='url(#plate)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='89' rx='22' ry='5' fill='#ffd968'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88.5' rx='15' ry='3.2' fill='#c9902f'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88.2' rx='13.5' ry='2.6' fill='#edb84a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='11' ry='2' fill='#fff0b8' opacity='0.75'/>

  <!-- warm glow pool on plate front -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92.5' rx='10' ry='1.8' fill='#ffb63c' opacity='0.45'/>
</svg>
